messages:
Sam (CEO): Thanks everyone — quick live thread to capture concrete asks from today's all-hands about customer wins/losses. Drop the core reason why we won or lost + a suggested owner and ETA.

Anna (Product): I'll start — wins we consistently hear: predictable latency, transparent perf benchmarks, and straightforward SDKs. Losses: on-prem/VPC friction and some security integrations (SAML/KMIP) still require hand-holding. I'll own the doc of top asks.

Mike (Sales): Win example: FinTechCo picked us b/c our Dedicated offering hit their 99th-pct latency targets and pricing was clearer than Competitor Y.

Mike (Sales): Loss example: GovHealth chose vendor Z — main reasons: air-gapped on‑prem package + SOC2 + HSM support. We didn't have an airgap-ready bundle.

Jordan (Eng): For GovHealth: root cause was our packaging assumptions (we expected outbound STS). Repro logs: ```error: unable to reach sts-endpoint - fqdn unreachable in airgapped env``` — we've scoped a runnable on-prem tarball but need infra validation. ETA: 6 weeks for a hardened build if prioritized.

Priya (Customer Success): From post-sale interviews: top asks are (1) clearer VPC/onboarding playbook, (2) dedicated SLA tiers for latency, (3) trial mode for Dedicated with limited usage and legal terms. I'll collate verbatim asks into a short deck.

Lee (Marketing): Suggest we create a short 'why we won' one-pager that highlights latency + transparent unit economics — good for sales enablement. Happy to draft with one customer quote.

Anna (Product): Owner suggestions: VPC docs -> Anna; On-prem distro -> Jordan; SLA tiers -> Sam/Revenue ops + Lauren (Legal) to sign off on pilot terms.

Sam (CEO): @Lauren can you comment on pilot PO-based pilots and limited SLA language? We had a couple of Sales asks for that.

Lauren (Legal): We can do a pilot template for PO-based pilots with limited SLA/cap of liability. Need product to define exact SLAs and a list of non-goals. I can draft template in 3 biz days once Product provides the baseline SLAs.

Mike (Sales): Revenue at risk estimate: two mid-market deals + one enterprise pilot ~ $600k ARR over first year if we don't unblock on-prem/VPC.

Anna (Product): I'll put a triage doc in Confluence with owners + priority. High-priority items: 1) VPC onboarding guide (2 wks) 2) On-prem hardened bundle (6 wks) 3) SLA pilot template (3 wks) 4) Billing visibility improvements (4 wks).

Jordan (Eng): I'll open a tracking ticket GH-2345 for the on-prem artifact and attach a minimal repro. Quick patch for the model loader (OOM on seq_len=4096) is in review — should reduce blocker calls.

Priya (Customer Success): Also repeatedly requested: a small evaluation harness we can hand to customers to run their prompts (sanitized) to validate model behavior. That reduces engineering lift for proof-of-concept. Owner?

Anna (Product): Assigning to @Priya to prototype a checklist and to @Jordan for a minimal harness. ETA: 2 weeks for checklist, 3 weeks for harness MVP.

OpsBot: Incident INC-2026-042 created for GovHealth packaging issues. OpsBot: assign -> Jordan (Eng).

Mike (Sales): One more ask from enterprise deals: can we publish a short migration playbook (from competitor X) — customers want to know data migration and latency comparison steps.

Lee (Marketing): We'll make a migration playbook template if Product provides the comparison data. Marketing can produce a customer-facing PDF in 1 week after data.

Sam (CEO): Actionable summary from me: Anna to publish triage doc today; Jordan to track on-prem GH ticket and aim for patches; Priya to collect top asks and draft eval harness spec; Lauren to draft pilot template after SLAs from Product. Sam to schedule a sync with Revenue Ops to quantify ARR at risk.

Anna (Product): I'll post the Confluence triage link in this thread when live and tag owners.

Priya (Customer Success): Will upload the verbatim customer asks (sanitized) to the doc — ETA EOD tomorrow.

Jordan (Eng): Quick note — if we prioritize this, can we pull an extra eng-week from infra for two sprints? Need confirmation from Sam/Eng leads.

Sam (CEO): We can reallocate. I'll confirm with Eng leads in the next 24h.

Mike (Sales): Thanks — this buys us a shot at converting those pilots.

Lee (Marketing): I'll line up a short case study draft for the FinTechCo win.

Sam (CEO): Great thread — please keep updates in the Confluence triage doc and drop short status replies here as items close. :thumbsup:
